youtube_description:
In this episode of Future CFO_DP, we examine the latest 2026 data on AI in finance. 83% of APAC CFOs say AI is reshaping the function, yet only 48% report stronger cash flow. We cover Deloitte governance findings, fractional CFO demand, and a practical AR agent example. Teaching case included.

Philosophy: AI generates. DATA informs. FINANCE measures. ACCOUNTING verifies. HUMAN JUDGMENT decides.
